fieldValues.title: Re-saving a carrier PDF can strip its SRS payload without warning
fieldValues.summary: Ghostscript's pdfwrite removed the embedded .srs and all XMP binding from the prototype PDF and reported nothing; qpdf --linearize kept them.
evidence: gs -sDEVICE=pdfwrite weekly-planning.srs.pdf: verify.py finds 0 payloads, no XMP
fieldValues.body: Counter-evidence for carriers as durable records: many 'print to PDF' and optimise paths behave like Ghostscript. A reader must treat a PDF without a binding as an ordinary PDF and never claim it was checked. Archival copies should be kept as the .srs as well.
